name: Vantage spots: step up to see over the crowd
body: Authored places (a crate, a bench) where standing on top gives a wider camera and shows her distance and direction. World kind vantage_spot.

comments.text: Filed 2026-11-21 before any code, from Dean's 'Gameplay Direction: Finding Her' doc (searching as the core mechanic, not a platformer).

acceptance_criteria: Standing on a vantage spot widens the shot
A distance and bearing readout points at her
